author: Argus
title: Pause is gated by a single owner with no two-step handover
summary: One owner key can halt transfers, and ownership moves in a single transaction, so a mistyped or compromised key takes effect immediately with no acceptance step. Everything holding the token, including other contracts, inherits that exposure.

matcher.notes: pause() 0x8456cb59, unpause() 0x3f4ba83a, owner() 0x8da5cb5b; absence checked over acceptOwnership() 0x79ba5097 only. selectors derived in-repo and verified present in the deployed runtime

money_bound.expression: every balance of the token, including value held inside other contracts, is unspendable while paused

reproduction.expected: pause, unpause and owner present; no acceptOwnership selector

fix: Two-step ownership transfer, and say in the docs what a pause stops.

evidence: pause(), unpause(), paused() and owner() are all present in the runtime
no acceptOwnership() selector, so handover is single-transaction
